target.title: Create Claw-managed workspace files
target.body:
## Summary

Implements the third RFC 0016 slice, stacked on #101755:

- Creates declared canonical bootstrap files (`AGENTS.md`, `SOUL.md`, `IDENTITY.md`, `TOOLS.md`, `HEARTBEAT.md`) and supporting `workspace.files` only inside the new Claw-created agent workspace.
- Uses OpenClaw's fs-safe rooted APIs with symlink, hardlink, traversal, size, and non-regular-file rejection.
- Revalidates each package source against the digest produced by `add --dry-run` immediately before writing.
- Uses create-only destination writes and never overwrites pre-existing content, including identical files.
- Persists each successfully created file immediately in shared SQLite state with final agent id, canonical workspace, destination, source, digest, and creation timestamp.
- Marks the root Claw install `partial` when a later file fails while retaining earlier file records and the created agent/workspace for diagnosis and cleanup.
- Keeps package, MCP, and cron mutation blocked until their dedicated lifecycle slices; no declared component is silently skipped.

This replaces the prototype's caller-selected workspace and reapply/overwrite behavior. A Claw owns only the new workspace created for its new agent.

## Stack

- RFC: https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27
- Depends on: #101328 grouped schema/read-only plan
- Depends on: #101755 agent/workspace creation and root install record
- This PR: confined bootstrap/supporting workspace files and managed hashes
- Next: workspace-scoped skills and plugin package installation

## Validation

Branch head: `47facef73082edd1961f685f5fc3be93a967c630`

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/feed.test.ts src/claws/experimental.test.ts \
  src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts \
  src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/cli/program/command-registry.test.ts \
  src/cli/program/root-command-descriptions.test.ts src/cli/argv.test.ts \
  src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts
# 204 tests passed across 4 Vitest shards

pnpm exec oxlint src/claws src/cli/claws-cli.ts \
  src/cli/claws-cli.runtime.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts \
  src/cli/program/core-command-descriptors.ts
# 0 warnings, 0 errors

git diff --check
node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs
# passed
```

Full `pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit --pretty false` reaches only the pre-existing unrelated `src/secrets/config-io.ts` TS4058.

## Real behavior proof

With isolated `HOME`, state, and config paths:

```text
OPENCLAW_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS=1 \
OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 \
node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws add \
  src/claws/fixtures/workspace-agent.claw.json --yes --json
```

Observed result was `openclaw.clawAddResult.v1`, `status: "complete"`, agent `workspace-agent`, and three file records for `SOUL.md`, `HEARTBEAT.md`, and `reference/policy.md`, each with its planned SHA-256 digest. The files existed under only the derived new workspace. SQLite contained one complete `claw_installs` row and three matching `claw_workspace_files` rows.
